title: bundle_end_anchors/end_apex discard pp.node_slot's ok — silent fallback to node slot 0
detail: A failed node_slot lookup silently yields slot 0, so anchors/apexes compute from the wrong node's geometry. Same pattern repeated in end_apex (lines 361-367). No OOB (slot 0 is valid whenever the topology is non-empty), but it contradicts the file's own defensive-bound helpers (node_kind_of/node_role_of/node_type_of) and the project's errors-are-values rule (never catch-and-ignore).
recommended_fix: Capture ok from pp.node_slot; on failure, emit no anchors (return empty) or fall back to the straight node-center path explicitly, matching the defensive style used elsewhere in wire_path.odin.
